definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.110) interface of an object lists the methods with their parameters, returned value and exceptions, word for word 2023 3.109 apart from 'may'/'can'; the rule names an interface as the language construct (§2002:4 4.111 'A grouping of method prototypes'), defined alike in 2023 3.110, so scope is unchanged. §2002:4 (4.150) procedure differs from 2023 3.145 in wording only, and SR13 uses 'procedure division', not 'procedure'; no change.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.121) method 'A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition' names the same entity 2023 describes in 9.3.4; the method definitions the rule places or refuses are the same source elements.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:9.3.5: 2002 binds an invocation by method-name alone (2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching); this rule is a placement or structure rule triggered by the word 'method' and involves no invocation or binding, so it does not rest on the changed text.
